schedules.title: Daily Compiler Primary
schedules.prompt: Operate only the Daily AI Brief Compiler in gttome/Daily-AI-Brief-Compiler. Do not access or modify gttome/Daily-AI-Brief. Resolve the target edition as the next America/Chicago calendar day. Reuse the existing execution if present; otherwise allocate exactly one. Read protected-main contracts first. Before editorial research read config/resource-registry.json and config/future-brief-inbox.json. Preserve valid persisted work and emit compact run/resource observations. IMAGE ROUTING: while contracts/d1-image-contract.json is proof_required, keep Proposal 1R as the pre-activation reader-image path. After D1 activation, seal six story image specifications and six unique composition assignments, set the image phase to SPEC_READY, persist state, and stop image generation in this semantic schedule. The separate D1 Work Cloud Browser image lane owns six fresh regular ordinary ChatGPT story chats and exact Git ingest. Do not generate reader images in this schedule. If a later invocation observes six accepted D1 images at GITHUB_VERIFIED, reuse them and continue BUNDLE. Never use Codex, paid APIs, TinyFish/other metered external browser services, owner file transfer, local computer, Supervisor, Watchdog Ring, leases, persistent workers, wake PRs, continuous AI polling, or runtime software repair.
